candidates.description: The addWalletBalance handler passes req.body.balance directly to WalletModel.increment without validating the amount is positive or bounded, allowing an authenticated user to inflate their wallet by any arbitrary value.
candidates.rationale: Line 27 calls WalletModel.increment({ balance: req.body.balance }) with no numeric validation or upper bound. The appendUserId middleware (server.ts:646) correctly binds UserId from the token, but the balance value itself is fully user-controlled, enabling arbitrary wallet inflation.
candidates.title: Unvalidated wallet balance increment allows arbitrary credit

candidates.description: The order handler reads req.body.UserId at line 146 to look up and decrement/increment wallet balances. If appendUserId middleware is not applied to this route, an attacker can specify any UserId to manipulate another user's wallet balance.
candidates.rationale: Lines 146-162 use req.body.UserId to find the wallet and call decrement/increment. The appendUserId middleware overwrites req.body.UserId from the JWT token, but the order route registration in server.ts has not been confirmed to include it. If absent, UserId is fully attacker-controlled.
candidates.title: Order route may use attacker-controlled UserId for wallet operations
